# pvecli config info

Show profile details.

```text
pvecli config info [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NAME` | Profile name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-a`, `--all` | Show all profiles. |
